title: Budget the complete experiment, not one circuit
description: Choose an illustrative execution target, then change the circuit, optimizer, mitigation, retry, and deadline assumptions. The budget includes every submitted task and every measurement shot.
modelNote: All prices, queue times, and device rates are teaching fixtures, not provider quotes or hardware predictions. Replace them with measured provider and circuit-specific values before making a purchasing or performance decision.
